description: Database engine: sqlite, postgres, mysql, sqlserver, oracle, teradata
SQLite: absolute path to the database file
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle: server host name or address
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle: TCP port (default 5432 for PostgreSQL, 3306 for MySQL, 1433 for SQL Server, 1521 for Oracle)
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server: database to connect to (for MySQL, also the default schema). Oracle: the service name (FREEPDB1, ORCLPDB1). Teradata: the default database
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, Teradata: login role, account or user (for SQL Server, a SQL Server login, or with auth windows another domain account)
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, Teradata: the login's password (a secret: env var or OS credential store)
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle: connect over TLS (Oracle: TCPS), verifying the server's certificate against the OS store
SQL Server: sql (a SQL Server login, the default) or windows (Windows authentication, Windows only)
SQL Server with auth windows: the domain of the account in user, to sign in as someone other than the current Windows user
Teradata: the Query Service base URL, e.g. https://teradata.imagile.dev:1443 (with any path in front of /systems, such as /api/query)
Teradata: the system's alias in the Query Service, as its administrator named it
Teradata: a bearer token for the Query Service, in place of user and password (a secret: env var or OS credential store)
Teradata: the session's logon mechanism (TD2, LDAP or JWT). Default: the system's own default
